item.title: Collect information of NAS members
item.description: When submitting to PNAS, you’re required to suggest NAS members. Since there are so many of them, manually browsing their profiles on the website is incredibly tedious. To solve this, I had AI write a Python script to collect information for members in relevant fields.The results were great—check out the code below. Beyond just writing code, AI is becoming an autonomous agent through tools like OpenClaw, bridging the gap between instructions and results.
